messages:
tori: Quick ping — global dashboard showed a p99 jump for /v1/respond at 03:12 UTC but when I drilled into endpoint breakdown p50/p95 looked fine. suspect a quota-driven spill to the "overflow" route. anyone seen this pattern before? :wave:
samir: can you paste a tiny sample slice + console link? need to see whether blended attribution is masking per-route behavior.
tori: console: https://console.redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/respond&range=30m
---
# samples (ts, route, latency_ms, quota_spill)
2026-05-02T03:11:45Z route=primary latency_ms=98 quota_spill=0
2026-05-02T03:12:01Z route=overflow latency_ms=880 quota_spill=1
2026-05-02T03:12:03Z route=overflow latency_ms=820 quota_spill=1
2026-05-02T03:12:10Z route=primary latency_ms=105 quota_spill=0
---
elena: looks like two overflow samples with huge latencies bumped the global p99. our UI currently only surfaces a blended p99 and a small legend; that hides the fact that overflow (n=6) dominated the tail. we should surface per-route contributor waterfall for percentiles.
kyle: backend note: telemetry currently emits route and a boolean quota_spill flag. timeseries API returns global quantiles + total_count only. Adding per-route pctl on-demand queries is expensive. we should precompute per-route p50/p95/p99 rollups at 1m granularity. storage hit likely small but need numbers.
samir: short-term UX fix: when a single non-primary route contributes >30% of the blended p99 value, show a yellow "quota-spill contributor" badge and expand the legend with top-3 contributing routes and their p99 + n. also show inline "n=" next to each percentile.
tori: +1. also add a small CI hint: if count < 40 show a yellow triangle "percentile noisy" with tooltip "n=6 — percentile unstable (95% CI wide)". even better if we show bootstrap range.
elena: agree. longer-term: we should add a "contributor waterfall" view: compute which routes contribute to the top X% of the p99 threshold and show stacked bars (route weight, p99, n). this helps triage when few high-latency routes inflate global percentiles.
kyle: API change proposal: add query param `attribution=blended|route|quota_spill` and `breakdown=route,region` to /timeseries. default keep backwards compat = blended. will draft spec and include deprecation notes for callers that assume a single blended number.
query-bot: debug job 88421 queued by samir: compute per-route counts for /v1/respond last 60m.
samir: action items: kyle -> cost estimate for 1m per-route rollups + small backfill plan; elena -> mockup for contributor waterfall + noisy CI indicator; tori -> add short runbook blurb about quota_spill badge and triage steps; i'll prototype the badge rule and add unit tests for the threshold logic.
ops-bot: ticket ROLLOUT-314 filed: "contributor waterfall + quota-spill badge + timeseries params". linked: infra/telemetry-cost and docs-runbook. owner: samir.
tori: thanks all. if this recurs I'll unmute paging for overflow route owners. marking resolved for now; follow-ups in ROLLOUT-314. :white_check_mark:
